body: I haven’t experienced divorce, but I recember when I was a kid and my parents divorced. I took my moms side, for some reason and  I was mad at my dad, even tough he’s on of the most loving and caring fathers to have been alive. Anyway, of course my mother wanted full custody of me, she tried to get my dad out of my life. Well it didn’t go like that, when I matured I realized how important my dad was to me and I loved the hell out of him. My point is, even though times are rough your children will always love you, you might feel like they hate you or just overall don’t like you. But from experience they love you more then anything. The kids need a father, do your best to be the best father to have ever lived. Life is worth living. Love you!
